verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile terminal and coding app, so reviewing pull requests from a phone is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no pull-request review feature. Its connection to VS Code for web and GitHub Codespaces is only an adjacent host-platform path: any PR review there would come from those services, not from Blink itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go
